description: This source file implements side effect tracking and management for TorchDynamo's compilation system, including handling mutations, attribute modifications, hooks, and context state during symbolic execution to ensure correctness of optimized code.

classes.name: SideEffects
classes.description: Main class for tracking and applying side effects such as mutations, attribute changes, hooks, and context modifications during TorchDynamo's symbolic execution and code generation processes.

methods.name: None ignore_mutations_on(self, var: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Marks a variable to ignore mutations during tracking, used for temporary mutations that are later restored.

methods.name: None stop_ignoring_mutations_on(self, var: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Unmarks a variable from being ignored for mutations, restoring normal tracking.

methods.name: None _capture_user_stack(self, key: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Records the current user stack trace for a specific variable to aid debugging side effects.

methods.name: "SideEffects" clone(self)
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the SideEffects instance for safe mutation or parallel processing.

methods.name: bool __contains__(self, item: Any)
methods.description: Checks if a variable is being tracked by the side effects.

methods.name: VariableTracker __getitem__(self, item: Any)
methods.description: Retrieves the tracked variable corresponding to a specific object.

methods.name: Optional[str] diff(self, other: "SideEffects")
methods.description: Compares two SideEffects instances to identify differences, useful for debugging and testing.

methods.name: None store_attr( self, item: VariableTracker, name: str, value: VariableTracker )
methods.description: Records an attribute mutation for a variable.

methods.name: VariableTracker load_attr( self, item: VariableTracker, name: str, deleted_ok: bool = False, check: bool = False, )
methods.description: Retrieves a stored attribute value for a variable, raising if deleted.

methods.name: None store_cell(self, cellvar: VariableTracker, value: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Stores a new value into a cell variable, asserting that the cell is mutable.

methods.name: VariableTracker load_cell(self, cellvar: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Reads the value from a cell variable, handling pending mutations.

methods.name: VariableTracker load_global(self, gvar: VariableTracker, name: str)
methods.description: Accesses a global variable's stored value.

methods.name: None store_global( self, gvar: VariableTracker, name: str, value: VariableTracker )
methods.description: Stores a value into a global variable.

methods.name: bool cls_supports_mutation_side_effects(cls: type)
methods.description: Determines whether a class's attribute access supports mutation side effects.

methods.name: bool is_attribute_mutation(self, item: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Checks if a variable tracks an attribute mutation.

methods.name: bool has_pending_mutation(self, item: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Checks if a variable has uncommitted mutations.

methods.name: bool has_pending_mutation_of_attr(self, item: VariableTracker, name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a variable has a pending mutation for a specific attribute.

methods.name: bool is_modified(self, item: VariableTracker)
methods.description: Determines if a variable has modifications that need to be applied.

methods.description: Creates and tracks a new object, setting up mutation tracking.
